summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would invalidate the Commonwealth environmental exemption for Western Australia's shark drum-line program and prevent future exemptions for drum lines used to catch sharks.

It would prohibit the environment minister from granting those exemptions under section 158 of the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act, applying specifically to shark-catching drum lines.
The proposal would take effect from its introduction on 25 March 2014, including withdrawal of the exemption allowing deployment of 72 baited drum lines.
changes: The exemption granted on 10 January 2014 would be voided.
Future environmental exemptions for shark-catching drum lines would be barred.
Commencement would be backdated to the bill's introduction date.
summary.affected: Shark drum-line operators and the Commonwealth environment minister would be affected.
